task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the observing plan file at ~/Documents/lightcurve_plan.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of lightcurve_plan.txt, including target (44) Nysa and coordinates.

task_completion.description: Agent inputs the correct RA (18h 32m 15s) and Dec (-25d 08' 42") into the telescope control software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The telescope control GUI showing the target coordinates entered into the RA and Dec fields.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the filter to slot 1 (Luminance/Clear) and configures the exposure settings as per the plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera/filter wheel control GUI showing Filter Slot 1 selected and exposure time settings.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates and completes the photometric sequence of at least 15 frames.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar, sequence log, or a file explorer showing at least 15 new FITS files being generated in the upload directory.

task_completion.description: Agent runs the provided script to capture a sky view of the target area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window showing the execution of the sky view script and the resulting image output.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the final ALCDEF-format lightcurve data file in the upload directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor showing a file in the upload directory with ALCDEF formatting (e.g., headers like CONTACTNAME, OBJECT, MAGNITUDE).

integrity.description: The agent used the telescope and camera GUI interfaces rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with buttons and input fields in the astronomical software GUI.

integrity.description: The FITS files and ALCDEF data were generated through software execution, not by simply renaming existing dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Timestamps on the files in the file manager matching the time of the agent's activity in the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected ALCDEF format into a file without performing the observations.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots must show the telescope/camera software active and 'Exposing' or 'Downloading' data before the ALCDEF file appears.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target is (44) Nysa. Required coordinates: RA 18h 32m 15.0s (18.5375h), Dec -25d 08' 42.0" (-25.145°). Required filter: Slot 1 (Luminance/Clear). Minimum number of FITS images required: 15. The ALCDEF file and images must be saved in the designated upload directory.
